subject: Re: Aligning on onsite walkthrough — constrained week, proposing split pre-brief + visit

From: Alice Chen <alice@hearthwell.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@hearthwell.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onsite walkthrough — availability week of Aug 16?

Hi Marissa / Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last month. Our team is planning a small client-facing field visit the week of Aug 16–22 and several of the stakeholders we want in the room (product, security, and IT) will be on-site at our Sacramento office that week. That creates a narrow window for any vendor visits.

High level ask: we want a 90-minute, hands-on walkthrough focused on integrations (SSO, VPC peering) and real-request latency for a 3–5k token context. Ideally it would be in-person at our office so our infra folks can ask detailed questions.

Availability constraints on our side:
- Aug 16–17: field event prep (not available)
- Aug 18: partial day (afternoon only)
- Aug 19: full day, but senior decision-maker flying out in evening
- Aug 20–22: external client event (unavailable)

Are you able to do anything on Aug 19 morning or Aug 18 afternoon? If not, do you have an option to split into a short remote pre-brief followed by an on-site visit after Aug 25?

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Director of Product Operations
Hearthwell Inc.

(attachment: stakeholder-list.xlsx [spreadsheet])

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@hearthwell.com>, Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@hearthwell.com>
Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite walkthrough — availability week of Aug 16?

Hi Alice — thanks for the details and the stakeholder list. Really helpful.

Quick note on our end: my product lead (Sergio) is on the road Aug 18–20 for another customer visit, so our on-site bandwidth that week is limited. We can do a 90-minute in-person session on Aug 19 in the morning (8:30–10:00 PDT) if that still works before your decision-maker departs. If the morning doesn't work, I can propose splitting it into:

Option A — Split (recommended):
- 30-minute remote pre-brief the week of Aug 16 (technical overview + targeted questions)
- 90-minute on-site deep dive the week of Aug 25 (when we have full engineering team available)

Option B — One-shot in-person: Aug 19, 8:30–10:00 PDT (we bring a small infra team)

I've attached an updated agenda (hearthwell-agenda_v2.pdf) that maps stakeholders to agenda items. If you confirm Option A, we can schedule the pre-brief for a short window that captures your IT/security + product (suggest Aug 17 or Aug 18 afternoon).

If you want to keep Sergio involved live for the on-site, Option A gives us better coverage. Happy to be flexible if the decision-maker's travel is immovable.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

(attachment: hearthwell-agenda_v2.pdf [PDF])

Date: 2026-08-03T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite walkthrough — availability week of Aug 16?

Marissa — thanks for the options and the agenda. A couple of updates from our side: our VP (Daniel Park) ended up changing travel and will be in Europe from Aug 18–26, which removes Aug 19 as a reliable window for him. He can join a short remote pre-brief, but won't be available in person until late Aug 26 onward.

Given the conflict with our field event (Aug 20–22) and Daniel's travel, here's what I propose:
- Pre-brief: Aug 25, 11:00–11:30 PDT (remote) — this will let Daniel join after he returns from Europe
- On-site deep dive: Sep 2, 09:00–10:30 PDT at our Sacramento office — this gives us a full week to coordinate logistics and get our infra folks scheduled.

If Redwood can do Aug 25 for the pre-brief and Sep 2 for the on-site, we can lock rooms and send a formal calendar invite. If splitting is a problem, please let me know ASAP and we'll try to reshuffle internally, but the field event dates are fixed.

Thanks — Natalie
Program Manager, Customer Integrations
Hearthwell Inc.
